title: EGALITARIANISM on LP2-43
question: Do the two fixed GP encodings of EGALITARIANISM fit the inferred LP2-43 slot [37,51) under one bijective substitution or any of 812 invertible affine decoders?
reader_question: Can one fixed alphabet turn this LP2-43 word into EGALITARIANISM?
summary: The 13-rune encoding has the wrong length. The 14-rune encoding requires the same ciphertext F to mean G and T; none of 812 affine decoders fits.
reader_finding: Using one rune for IA gives 13 runes for a 14-rune word. Keeping I and A separate gives 14, but the same cipher rune F would need to mean both G and T. None of 812 fixed affine decoders fits.
reader_limit: These are newly specified fixed-alphabet tests. The 2019 proposal did not specify a cipher, and its mapping diagrams remain uninspected; this does not reject that broader idea.
finding: At the one inferred 14-rune slot [37,51), the IA-one encoding fails the 13-versus-14 whole-slot length gate. The separate-I/A encoding conflicts with one static bijection: ciphertext F at word positions 2 and 6 would require G and T, with two additional inverse-map conflicts. There are zero bijective extensions and zero fits among all 812 invertible affine decoders P = aC + b modulo 29.
limitations: One source-inferred slot and two exact GP encodings only. The historical author explicitly did not assume a monoalphabetic cipher, and no transformation or independently expected continuation is recovered. The inaccessible original/corrected mapping diagrams were not inspected. Other ciphers, encodings and slots remain untested; the affine test is a subset of the bijection test, not independent corroboration.
next_steps: Recover the original mapping diagram and mathematical transformation before claiming an exact historical replay. Any other encoding, slot or cipher needs its own fixed specification.

scope.representation: One inferred complete 14-rune word [37,51), zero-based page-rune indices including headings. Last 10 runes of physical line 2 plus first 4 of line 3; exterior hyphens delimit, internal slash/newline is a transparent wrap. Exact GP Latin labels only, indices 0–28 rather than prime values.
scope.procedure: Apply the whole-slot length gate to the two fixed spellings; check forward/inverse static-bijection consistency; enumerate every invertible affine decoder P = aC + b modulo 29 on the eligible spelling and retain every mismatch.
scope.parameters: One slot; two encodings of 13 and 14 runes; one eligible encoding; all 812 affine decoders a = 1..28, b = 0..28. Four planted 274-rune contexts, 1,624 affine-key plants, three deliberate failure fixtures and 7,722 exhaustive small-alphabet pair controls.
scope.exclusions: Other slots/pages, aliases or spelling changes, sliding a 13-rune fragment into the 14-rune word, nulls/padding/deletions, transposition, repeating keys, interruptions, language ranking, significance claims and the unspecified historical cipher.
